request.state:
Icelandic original: „Það er eitthvað sérstakt við þetta safn og stykkishólm. Ég var alveg dáleidd af því og vildi ekki fara þaðan. Ég hef  aldrei fundið fyrir jafn mikilli ró og ég fann fyrir þar.“
English gloss: “There is something special about this museum and Stykkishólmur. I was completely enchanted by it and did not want to leave. I have never felt as much peace as I felt there.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
